<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect data-miro-id="3458764690584669943" data-content="<b>Controlled self-service for QA</b><br>QA requests an approved template, release, size and expiry through a Jira form or permitted workflow.<br>DevOps owns templates and limits; automation runs Terraform using a scoped identity.<br>Sales and pilot requests keep separate acceptance, data and lifecycle rules." data-rendered-bounds="-1456 15820 1984 160" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584669985" data-content="<b>1. Request an environment [QA / owner]</b><br>QA: approved template, release, size, owner and expiry.<br>Use a Jira form or a workflow QA is permitted to run.<br>Sales/pilot: name business and technical owners." data-rendered-bounds="1715 15780 640 192" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584669988" data-content="<b>2. Validate the request [Automation]</b><br>Check approved versions, access, purpose and limits.<br>Check size, cost, data policy and expiry.<br>Allocate instance ID and ownership scope." data-rendered-bounds="1715 16068 640 192" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584669989" data-content="<b>3. Final plan and approval</b><br>Automation plans for this target and isolated state.<br>Pilot: DevOps approves each final QA plan.<br>Later: approved policy for proven requests in limits.<br>Custom, larger or sensitive requests need approval." data-rendered-bounds="2547 16068 640 192" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670001" data-content="<b>4. Provision infrastructure [Automation]</b><br>DevOps maintains the template and scoped execution identity.<br>Automation applies the exact authorized saved Terraform plan.<br>Verify resources and outputs; stop on failed or partial apply." data-rendered-bounds="3379 16068 840 192" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670003" data-content="<b>6. Check readiness [Automation]</b><br>Verify versions, health, access, accounts and integrations.<br>Return environment URL and status to the requester.<br>Notify QA and DevOps if setup is not ready." data-rendered-bounds="2547 16356 640 192" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670007" data-content="<b>Each purpose follows its own lifecycle</b><br>QA: approved expiry starts automated cleanup; permitted resets and extensions follow policy.<br>Demo: reset between agreed sessions. Pilot: retain active data; owner approves retirement/export.<br>DevOps handles cleanup failures. Never apply QA expiry to active customer use." data-rendered-bounds="1715 16932 1472 224" />
<textArea data-miro-id="3458764690584670009" data-rendered-bounds="1339 17317 3024 26" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670016" data-content="<b>2. Design reusable environment profiles</b><br>DevOps owns templates, scoped identities and limits.<br>Add a Jira request form or permitted workflow.<br>Start with DevOps approval of every final QA plan.<br>Keep QA, demo and pilot data/lifecycle separate." data-rendered-bounds="5970 15828 636 256" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670018" data-content="<b>3. Prove each profile in a trial</b><br>QA requests an environment and receives URL/status.<br>Test approval, isolation, limits, expiry and failures.<br>Rehearse demos; verify multi-student pilot journeys.<br>Record results and owner acceptance." data-rendered-bounds="6766 15828 636 256" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670020" data-content="<b>4. Launch and operate agreed instances</b><br>Publish request, acceptance and failure guidance.<br>Agree automatic policy only for proven routine QA.<br>Exceptions keep approval; customer use stays controlled.<br>Review costs, cleanup failures and retirement." data-rendered-bounds="7562 15828 636 256" />
<rect data-miro-id="3458764690584670052" data-content="• Jira form or permitted workflow; what access does QA need?<br>• Who approves exceptions and owns failed setup/cleanup?<br>• Which size, cost, data and expiry limits allow routine QA?<br>• Which support, acceptance and change rules apply by purpose?<br>• Which data, backup/restore and retirement rules apply?" data-rendered-bounds="6766 16700 1432 224" /></svg>
